correctness.rationale: A tuple-orbit proof converts four-round graph games to exact equality-partition histogram extensions. A complete twenty-seven-state capped-distance transition system proves T^C=T^(C+1) on every singleton input state for all allowed patterns. This gives pair caps (A,B)=(6,8) or (5,9), both summing to 14, proving the uniform infinite tail. Exact recursion for dimensions 1–14 yields sixteen pairwise distinct rank-four types with stated class identities; a separate direct-vertex implementation agrees on small cases. This proves the full theorem in the specified signature; no infinite inference relies on finite sampling.

value.rationale: A natural two-parameter distance-regular family has an exact fourth-order logical phase diagram, sharply contrasting the known binary threshold six with new nonbinary threshold five and establishing alphabet saturation at four. The combined sixteen-class theorem and optimal 1024-vertex family representative are structural, motivated by bounded logical expressiveness rather than arbitrary finite cases.
